message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Province/territory | Notes |
|------|---------|--------------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | All provinces & territories | Monday |
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | Ontario | Monday (since Jan 1 was Sunday) |
| **February 20** | Family Day | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba | Monday |
| **March 20** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | Friday |
| **March 23** | Easter Monday | Quebec | Monday |
| **April 7** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | Monday |
| **May 22** | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Northwest Territories, Nunavut | Monday |
| **May 29** | Victoria Day (observed) | Ontario | Monday (since May 28 was Sunday) |
| **June 19** | Canada Day | All provinces & territories | Saturday (observed June 20 in some provinces) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | All provinces & territories | Saturday |
| **July 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Ontario | Monday (since July 1 was Saturday) |
| **August 7** | Civic Holiday | British Columbia, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador | Monday |
| **September 18** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | Monday |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | Monday |
| **November 10** | Thanksgiving (observed) | Ontario | Monday (since Oct 31 was Sunday) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | Monday |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | All provinces & territories | Tuesday |

These dates create either a Monday‑Friday or Saturday‑Sunday long weekend. Some provinces observe the holiday on a different day if it falls on a weekend (e.g., Ontario observes New Year’s Day on Monday, 2 Jan). If you need the exact observed dates for each province, let me know!
